ValidationRule.description: End Date Time must be present when span inputs are complete (set by before-save flow).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date_Time__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Span_Type__c))), OR( ISPICKVAL(Span_Type__c, "Full_Day"), NOT( AND( ISBLANK(TEXT(Span_Duration_Select__c)), ISBLANK(Span_Duration__c) ) ) ), ISBLANK(End_Date_Time__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End Date Time could not be calculated. Check Start, Span Type, and Span Duration (for Partial (Hours)).
